name: pixiwechattest
description: TypeScript、Three.js 与 PixiJS 微信小游戏框架

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --define:BUILD_PROFILE=\"basic\"
scripts.build:model: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --define:BUILD_PROFILE=\"model\"
scripts.build:app: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --define:BUILD_PROFILE=\"app\"
scripts.build:app:model: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --define:BUILD_PROFILE=\"app-model\"
scripts.build:webgl2: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --define:BUILD_PROFILE=\"webgl2\" --define:WebGL2RenderingContext=globalThis.WebGL2RenderingContext
scripts.build:webgl2:model: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --define:BUILD_PROFILE=\"webgl2-model\" --define:WebGL2RenderingContext=globalThis.WebGL2RenderingContext
scripts.build:ui: npm run typecheck && npm run bundle -- --define:BUILD_PROFILE=\"pixi-ui\"
